name: independent-evidence-plus-full-translator-v3
hypothesis: An independent evidence specialist improves an otherwise unchanged translation agent when its report is added to, rather than substituted for, the translator's normal examples, project access, tools, and research discretion.
activation_condition: For every language, an evidence-only Luna session writes a cited report; a fresh Luna translator then receives the complete ordinary few-shot prompt and project plus that report as optional supporting context.
fallback: The translator may ignore, correct, or extend any report claim and use the exact supplied examples and full project exactly as it would without the report.
falsifier: The additive method fails if it does not improve paired translation quality over the ordinary staged harness, or if the translator loses access to any baseline example, project evidence, tool, or independent research behavior.
agent_instructions: Two independent agents contribute to the task. RESEARCHER: gather high-value evidence from the supplied examples and project, cite it precisely, and write .runner/report.md without drafting translations. TRANSLATOR: operate as the complete normal translation agent with the exact few-shot examples, full supplied project, tools, and freedom to conduct further research. The report is only optional extra context: verify, ignore, correct, or extend it as appropriate. The target examples, not the language label or report prose, define observable project conventions.
research_prompt: Act only as an evidence researcher for all three tasks. Inspect the exact few-shot examples, immediate passage context, semantic parallels, and target-side concordances in the supplied project. Write a concise .runner/report.md with one section per task containing source propositions and semantic roles that must survive; the most relevant directly attested source-target evidence with exact row or example citations; genuine conflicts or gaps; and clearly labeled tentative observations. Do not draft or recommend a complete translation. End after the cited report exists.
translation_prompt: You are the translation agent, not a passive consumer of the research report. You have the complete ordinary few-shot examples and full supplied project. Use your normal research workflow and local tools whenever useful. Read .runner/report.md only as fallible additional research; verify material claims, correct or ignore weak claims, and conduct any further investigation needed. Produce one coherent translation per task that follows the supplied target examples and preserves every source proposition, participant and semantic role, relation, polarity, quantity, and name. Return only the controller-required structured JSON.
